instruction: Trim-Based Stair Stringer Cutout Read `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\stair_spec.json` and export `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.skp` for a stringer-like part whose overall dimensions match that spec. Ensure that only three dimensions: the X span must equal `stringer_length_m`, one overall extent must equal `stringer_height_m + treads * rise_per_step_mm / 1000`, and the thinnest extent must equal `stringer_thickness_m`, each within `10 mm`. [Software] Launch SketchUp with `C:\SketchUp 2026 26.0.429 x64 En Portable\SketchUp.exe` (adjust if your install differs).
